routing_warnings.description: The first scope question reports that invited users lack a working acceptance route and landing flow.
The second scope question reports that disconnect endpoints return success without removing the connection record.
The second scope question reports that the front end correctly refuses to display success when disconnection has not occurred.
The third scope question reports that per-member metering is unavailable to account owners.
The separate statement that the front end correctly refuses to claim disconnect success supports the success-feedback Requirement rather than connection-record revocation.
The completion statement concerns delivery of the Release 1 audit, not implementation or verification of instant connection revocation.
The explicit completion claim concerns delivery of the front-end Release 1 audit, not implementation of the invited-user acceptance flow.
